ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution comprising approximately 80% of the surface area, with localized high-intensity (white/off-white) clusters concentrated on the distal margins and scattered near the peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous mottling is mapped to the outer distal regions of both lobes, with a larger, more fragmented white patch on the right distal lobe and a more concentrated patch on the left distal lobe. Small, isolated high-intensity pixels are visible near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated angle of 70-80 degrees, extending deeply toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency serrations with varying pixel amplitudes; prominent sharp peaks are located along the primary trailing edge of both lobes, interspersed with shallower valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature originating from the median notch and sweeping upward to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, dense clusters of high-contrast white circular pixels (consistent with barnacle colonization) are located exclusively at the apex of the left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned light-intensity linear pixel disruptions are visible across the dark mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the distal tips; irregular serration pattern suggests minor edge-tissue loss along the trailing margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical white mottling patterns on distal edges against a near-uniform black central fluke body.
